title: Per-run result sets with a dataset table view and server-side export
summary: Give every crawl, batch and extract run an append-only result set (JSONL in the artifact store, indexed by run) behind GET /v1/runs/{id}/items?format=csv|jsonl|xlsx&fields=&omit=, with a dataset table view in the Ingestions page and a per-org retention policy. ZDR runs stream items and persist nothing. Ingestion into the Data Plane stays an explicit, selective decision.
whyItMatters: Users extracting structured data (prices, listings, procurement notices) need a table they can inspect, filter and export without forcing everything into the Data Plane. Today the Ingestions page shows runs, schedules, monitors, sources, evidence and profiles but no result data.

referenceBestPractice.bestSource: Apify (dataset, key-value store and request queue per run)
referenceBestPractice.mechanism: Run creation allocates dataset_id, kv_id and queue_id and injects them into the run. The dataset is append-only (items up to 9 MB) and exports server-side with format=csv|jsonl|xlsx|xml|rss, field projection (fields, omit, clean) and hidden #-prefixed debug fields. The KV store holds content-typed records for blobs and state; named storages persist indefinitely while unnamed ones expire after about 7 days; per-object rate limits return 429.

verevonToday.gap: SRC and baseline: artifact storage (memory, filesystem, S3 with content addressing), a durable Postgres URL frontier and Data Plane ingest exist, but there is no per-run result set, no dataset or key-value API, no export formats and no dataset browser; the SPA's Quarry client (quarry-client.ts) is unused code.

approach: Ingestion Plane: at job completion write each result item to a JSONL object in the artifact store under org/run, with an index row in Postgres, and add the items route with the export formats and projection. Retention policy per org (default expiry, longer for named sets); ZDR returns items on the stream only. Frontend: dataset table view in the Ingestions run detail with an 'ingest to Data Plane' action and a download menu. Optional output schema fields arrive with R-t2-06-06.
dependencies: Optionally F-t2-053 for typed field metadata
risks: Must stay a working set with retention, not a second Data Plane (no retrieval or graph). Export of large sets needs streaming. Items can contain sensitive scraped content, so ACLs follow the run owner.

verevon.exactGap: No per-run result set, dataset or key-value API, export formats or dataset browser exist: the edge route table has artifacts list/get, jobs list, run and job events, sources, snapshots and team aggregates only (routes.rs:130-293), ArtifactSummary has no run_id and the list has no run filter even though artifact keys are laid out org=/run/page_hash/kind/id (resources.rs:83-97, artifact_store.rs:186-200). The Ingestions page has runs, schedules, monitoring, sources, evidence (job events) and profiles but no result data (VerevonIngestionsPage.tsx:67-114); manual extract results are returned once inline as ephemeral evidence under a synthetic run id (ingestions/runs.rs:268-340), and the SPA quarry-client.ts is used only by its own test. Structured /v1/extract is synchronous and persists nothing.
reuse: ArtifactStore with per-run key layout (org=/run_id/page_hash/kind/id) and tenant-bound get_with_key: add a run_id field and filter to the artifact list instead of a second store.

page_extracted events (title, excerpt, summary, word_count, lang, driver; routes.rs:776-830, event.rs) already stored in control per job and served by GET /v1/runs/:id/events and /v1/jobs/:id/events: a ready-made per-page row source for crawl and batch.
Gateway /api/ingestions/runs and /api/ingestions/evidence plus the Evidence panel as the place to attach a results table.
Selective ingest to the Data Plane (crawl ingest flag, CrawlPagePicker) for the explicit promote action.
Quarry retention janitor in control (main.go:197-201, inert unless QUARRY_RETENTION_DAYS is set) for retention policy.
verevon.constraints: ZDR: /v1/crawl and /v1/batch are refused for ZDR callers (routes.rs:555-575), so a durable run result set never applies to ZDR; only synchronous scrape and extract can run under ZDR and those must stay stream-only. The result set must remain a working set with retention, not a second Data Plane (no retrieval or graph); Data Plane ingest stays an explicit decision. ACL: artifact reads are tenant (org) bound (resource_routes.rs:125-155), not per actor, so per-owner result visibility would be new work. Stored items can hold sensitive scraped content, so export must be streamed and audited.
verevon.approachAdjustment: Do not start with a new JSONL store plus Postgres index plus xlsx export. Smaller path: (1) add run_id to ArtifactSummary and a run filter on /v1/artifacts (S); (2) project per-page rows for crawl and batch from page_extracted events plus artifact refs, exposed as GET /v1/runs/{id}/items with csv and jsonl export streamed by the edge or gateway (M); (3) a table view in the Ingestions run detail with an ingest action. A durable structured result set only becomes meaningful once structured extraction runs as a durable job (today /v1/extract is synchronous and unpersisted), so tie the JSONL dataset design to that dependency rather than to existing runs.
verevon.effortNote: M for the projection-based approach; the item as originally designed (new JSONL store, Postgres index, retention policy, xlsx, table UI) is L.
verevon.verdictReason: The feature does not exist and the gap description is accurate, but the proposed storage design overbuilds when per-run artifact keys and page_extracted events already exist. Keep as a medium-priority item with the lighter projection approach and the durable-extract dependency stated.
